_comment: Guards the Ancestral Anger -> Fists of Flame draw multiplier, the interaction that makes Anger competitive with a card that deals far more damage on its own (measured 2026-08-19: Draught beats Anger by 16 damage with no Fists, ties at one, LOSES by 16 at two). Same board as draught_magnet_escalation plus 2 more lands. Anger at the magnet is +1/+0 x4 AND draws 4 cards; Fists then draws first and counts cards_drawn_this_turn per copy, so its instances escalate 6/7/8/9 off Anger's refill instead of 2/3/4/5. 6 base + 4 + 30 = 40, so opponent_life 40 is EXACTLY lethal. If Anger's per-copy cantrip stops feeding Fists' count, this drops to 20 and fails.
